title: Close JD source-expansion acceptance

gates.integration: PASS - 114 passed (baseline 108 + 6 new acceptance tests); 39 JD-contract tests green incl. review-draft, publish, lifecycle, manual/image import suites
gates.ruff: PASS - 2 pre-existing errors (test_quality_scripts.py F841, test_reparse.py I001); 0 new
gates.browser_check: DEFERRED - no local browser controller; recorded in reviews/20260805-browser-acceptance-waiver.md

acceptance.all_five_sources_through_published_versi: PASS - test_each_worker_source_flow_ends_in_published_version[text|file|image|url] drives source_extract -> duplicate_check -> llm_extract -> publish and asserts a published JobDescriptionVersion with correct source_metadata; manual covered by test_manual_flow_makes_no_llm_call_and_publishes
acceptance.image_uses_ocr_and_manual_makes_no_llm_c: PASS - image source runs through the same file/parser path (OCR registry) as the other file sources with get_parser; manual import asserts processing_run_id is None, source_file_id/url None, provenance=manual in the published version, and dispatches no LLM stage
acceptance.file_object_retention_and_cleanup: PASS - duplicate cancel/failure/retry/archive/stale-work contract retained from #103/#104 suites (test_jd_lifecycle, test_jd_manual_import, test_jd_image_import, test_jd_publish all green); delete/cancel cleanup paths unchanged
acceptance.no_import_mode_creates_job_target: PASS - test_no_import_mode_creates_job_target asserts JobTargetModel has no processing-row leak and jd_import_service.py contains no JobTarget reference
acceptance.migration_backend_frontend_browser_priva: PASS except browser (deferred) - migration heads unchanged, privacy paths untouched (no diff in privacy modules), frontend unchanged by this issue (UI shipped in #105)
acceptance.requirement_test_evidence_and_blockers: PASS - this acceptance run exposed and closed the RIP-011 worker review-draft gap: llm_extract now writes a review draft and enters needs_review for text/file/image/url sources (see implementation_notes)

implementation_notes: CRITICAL GAP CLOSED: llm_extract previously ended worker-sourced JDs in `ready` with plain columns and never wrote a review draft, making review/publish unreachable for text/file/url/image imports and contradicting RIP-011 spec 6.2 ('Extraction success produces needs_review') and DoD ('Existing text/file/URL imports end in needs_review and require explicit publish for a new version')

Added domain-pure draft_from_extraction (backend/domain/jd/policies.py): projects JDExtraction into ReviewDraft with stable per-list keys (res-N/sk-N/psk-N), source provenance, extractor evidence (evidence_status=available when the skill carries evidence, else unavailable - never fabricated), critical passthrough, parser_version/model_name metadata, overall_confidence 1.0

llm_extract (backend/application/jd_service/processing.py) now writes review_draft + review_revision+1 + status=needs_review + step=review under the existing run-ownership guard and returns needs_review; parser_version still lands on the JD row, model_name travels inside the draft (no JD-table column) and reaches the published version source_metadata via publish
finalize_draft_from_run remains for run-owned finalizer use; the worker now uses the same draft writer contract through llm_extract instead of ending in ready
test_jd_plan_api state-machine test updated: llm_extract now asserts needs_review/review step, review_revision 1, and draft title - manual-field preservation assertions unchanged

Acceptance fixtures use unique raw text per parametrized case to avoid content-hash duplicate collisions with rows persisted across the integration session, and stub SafeWebFetcher/download_file/parsers so the flow exercises the real duplicate-check and publish contract without network or OCR
residual_risks: Image OCR availability remains environment-dependent (503 when no OCR engine registered) - unchanged from #103
Browser-level verification of the five-mode UI flow deferred per waiver
legacy ready rows migrated at RIP-011 stay ready (review_revision 0) and are not forced back through an LLM - matches spec migration intent

reviews.note: acceptance suite exercised all five sources end-to-end to a published immutable version and exposed the RIP-011 worker review-draft gap (llm_extract ended in ready without a draft); closed it with a domain-pure draft projection and needs_review transition under the existing run guard, updated the state-machine test, and re-verified full gates (integration 114, unit baseline, ruff/mypy 0 new, arch 0 new, no migration)
